name: create_flow
title: Create a flow
description:
Create a new flow as a draft: blank, or from a template (`template_key` from `list_flow_templates`). A
draft answers nobody: build it with `edit_flow`, rehearse it with `rehearse_flow`, check it with
`check_flow`, and switch it on with `set_flow_status` when the person agrees.

template_key.description: From `list_flow_templates`. Leave it out for a blank flow.

settings.description: Blank flows only: language, max_ai_replies and so on.
